rule:
Spaces in the same building storey must share the same bottom elevation.

Source: BIM validation rule 'Same-storey elevation' of the EC3-2026 rule catalogue (general space check: spaces in the same storey share a bottom elevation).
A space fails when the bottom of its modelled volume differs by more than 10 mm from the bottom elevation shared by most spaces of the storey it belongs to. Area and zone objects that are not rooms (IfcSpace with PredefinedType USERDEFINED, e.g. AREA_GFA or AREA_STRATA, or any IfcSpace carrying an IFC-SG area property set such as SGPset_SpaceArea_GFA) are not assessed: label them NA.
Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcSpace) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.
notes: EC3 same-storey elevation rule on all IfcSpace: {'FAIL': 19, 'NA': 4, 'PASS': 186}.

reference.status: Coded reference from IfcSpace geometry and spatial aggregation; no value lies between 1 mm and 50 mm from the shared level.
reference.policy: Shared level = most common rounded bottom elevation of the storey's room spaces; tolerance 10 mm. USERDEFINED spaces and spaces carrying IFC-SG area property sets are NA.
reference.limitations: A BIM consistency rule, not a building regulation: intentional raised or sunken floors (kitchens, wet areas) are reported as violations, as the rule states.
